id: title:Gilbert09:make two shard order dependent tests self contained

review.posthog_relevance: Adds documentation and test isolation for the persons deduplication command and identity provisioning, preserving logging state and mocking environment variables.
review.reason: The change P1.F1.H1 restores logging state and global disable flags after a test assertion, preserving configuration while asserting INFO records are emitted. P1.F2.H1 replaces a test implementation with mocked identity and API URL, retaining the original function and docstring. These are localized, bounded maintenance and test improvements.
review.uncertainty: No runtime behavior or production benefit is demonstrated; tier is assigned solely on the presence of documentation and test isolation, not on observed benefit or systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds explicit restoration of logging state and global disable flag after a test assertion, and adds a docstring explaining why this is done.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves logging configuration while asserting that the persons dedup command emits INFO records; restores original disabled and global disable settings after the assertion.

observations.behavior: Adds a docstring and three @patch decorators to a test, replacing the original function definition.
